en: Black-and-white vintage street view showing a broad cobbled market square lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. A tall, slender tower with a clock or observation platform rises prominently in the center background, likely attached to a historic town hall. People walk along the sidewalks, and a bicycle is parked by the curb. The caption at the bottom reads "Löwenberg i. Schl. – Marktplatz," and a small printer's logo appears in the lower right corner.
